policy.principle: Zero direct production imports does not mean no value. Evidence counts are reliable, while value and disposition require judgment.
policy.deletion_rule: A delete candidate requires no meaningful consumers or evidence role and still needs separate approval before removal.
policy.p12_constraint: context, llm, and perception remain retained with B-level reachability conclusions; do not judge their availability or delete them from static-zero evidence.

modules.evidence: No product import. Three test modules cover genuine INP parsing and quad/hex Jacobian audits. It wraps mesh_gate. Current production mesh_quality is a separate native Abaqus verifyMeshQuality action chain, so this module is offline INP audit coverage. C3D10M tetrahedra are unsupported by this parser.

No product import. Two test modules and three qualification tools use a 22-case official benchmark catalog with citations, reference values, tolerances, and parameter contracts. It supports reproducible benchmark qualification.

No product import. One test module verifies image magic/CRC, metadata alignment, bounded slicing, and full-image blocking. Perception package is explicitly not enabled on solve path and is retained under P12.

Imported and re-exported by results/__init__.py. Importing results submodules from agent.py loads this module. Tests cover scalar/hotspot/evidence queries, raw-array blocking, budgets, and token reduction. It is a bounded result access contract.

No product import. Eight test files and five tools use it. Production acceptance has a mandatory contact_diagnostics gate and reports consume diagnostic objects. contracts/contact.py defines the result types, while this module computes diagnostics from evidence.

No product import. One comprehensive test module exercises adaptive refinement, convergence, singularity stopping, budget exhaustion, and evidence fail-closed behavior. execution/convergence.py is product-used.
No product import. One test module and one drawing-to-ODB qualification tool use it to compute perception precision/recall/F1 against ground truth. Perception is not enabled on solve path.
No product import. One test module covers valid Face/Edge/Vertex resolution plus findAt failures, ambiguity, and instance mismatch. It is a small safety validator for Abaqus repository locators.
No import found in src, tests, tools, or docs. Its generic names caused false-positive text counts. It is a tiny dataclass-to-JSON helper duplicating standard serialization utilities.
No product import. One test module checks the weighted normalized score and validation. The formula is generic and may overlap grounding/ranking.py.
No import found. actions/builders.py already defines and package-re-exports python_action. The historical test/tool counts are text hits for the shared symbol, not consumers of this module.
No import found in src, tests, tools, or docs. ExperimentInput is a small frozen dataclass with no consumer. Historical test/tool counts are text hits, not module imports.

scope_discrepancy.evidence: Omitted from the 12-module table but marked TEST-ONLY in _ast_verify.txt. It defines three simple BenchmarkCase values and has one direct test import. contracts/benchmarks_catalog.py is a separate official 22-case catalog.
